model.description: The drag-and-drop buffer payload is the scenario UNIT JSON (the full {ior,ownerIor,model} object) — NEVER a *.show?uuid= URL, a WebItem, or any link. A FILE drags as a FILE (not a collection). Detail views actually RENDER for every /model tree selection (today empty on all). ★ FLEET-WIDE (Tron amendment 'this affects the onDrop to diagramms and everywhere else'): ONE shared serializer produces the payload ONCE + ONE shared resolver consumes it ONCE; EVERY drop target reuses it (diagram, room, /model tree/collections/folders, editor/detail drawer, and any future target) — NO per-target payload format, NO per-target parsing, NO *.show?uuid= URL fallback ANYWHERE. Same duplication-collapse shape as R40.37 (per-view if-chains -> one shared declaration).

discoverySource.note: Cluster A + fleet-wide amendment. The unit-carrying drop contract is single-source across all targets; architect designs the shared serializer/resolver.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A FILE drags as a FILE (its file scenario-unit), NOT a collection: dragging src/.../DeviceEnrollDialog.ts yields the File unit, never #collection.show?uuid=file:... .

The DnD buffer payload is the scenario UNIT JSON (full {ior,ownerIor,model}) in ALL cases — NEVER a *.show?uuid= URL, a #webitem.show link, or any URL/webitem. ALWAYS the actual unit (this is why cross-instance drops produced plain-URL WebItems).
Detail views actually RENDER for EVERY /model tree selection (today: empty on all) — file details are shown for all files, not a blank drawer.

ONE shared serializer produces the payload + ONE shared resolver/deserializer consumes it; EVERY drop target reuses the SAME contract (diagram/room/tree-collection/editor-drawer + future) — NO per-target format, NO per-target parsing, NO *.show?uuid= URL fallback anywhere (single-source, R40.37 shape).

The BITE asserts the contract PER TARGET (diagram · room · tree/collection · editor/drawer) + STUB-MUST-FAIL: make the serializer emit a URL/*.show again -> assert RED. A target that regresses to a link is caught by construction.

[DEVICE-ONLY @390 pixel — Tron on phone, un-mockable, NEVER headless-green, TRON-ONLY] Tron verifies on device: a file drags as a file, drops onto every target carry the unit (not a URL), and detail views render.
